content: Fefel Kowe Re Dabey Jesus
Te sulay mo wol miril ngo Jesus sala malekah fedal wol sew mo sew haplom le yela foloyu Hapatpat Momay we kofal mala Lamliyel Deus. Chowe seg mo rumal re dabey,
iwe mo wol tot fefel le yesa hachuya moniyan mo metmetal tomay mo uwor: Mary (we rema ffesang ngali bo Magdalene), we ye chuy fismol moniyan mo uwol.
Iwe mo Joanna we ril Chuza we semal rechokwe ye tagiyet mo irel imw we imwel Yerodes; iwe mo Susanna mo wol tot fefel le re tapeli mekla hamaler llufulyer bo hammalel Jesus mo mokwe redabeyal.
Fiyongol Chol Fadol Milay We
Resa rorodoh chog yarmat mo wol sew mo sew haplom irel Jesus. Yodwe sa cholop doh yarmat ngo Jesus yesa kangalu fiyong le:
“Ye mel semal mal le yela fadgu milay la yal. Yodwe yela hamro faesol ire kowe yal woal milay we, ngo tot ye ppungdiy lal yalap, iwe yarmat resa suru fedaley ngo mael yeyal re budoh resa hangiloh.
Tot ikla ye pungdiy lobos kala ye faesfos. Ye tumuldah ngo ye betbatloh bo ye telap chael lobowe.
Tot fedah kowe ye pungdiy luwul ire kowe yor chil re sala tumul sewdah iwe sala farorloh fedah kowe irel ire kowe yor chil.

Iwe ngo tot ila ye pungdiy loboka ye momay bol iyang. Yela tumuldah yee la paleng sala yor uwal le be sehay ngo kasubguy uwal.” Iwe ngo Jesus sa hasiyaloh yal hapatpat le ye sor bo, “Ha talenga hare yor talengmi!”
Fael Fiyong Kowe
Mokwe redabeyel Jesus re kasiya hare meda fael fiyong we.

Jesus yesa kangalur bo, “Repiy la ye llebag le kofal mala Lamliyel Deus ila yesa yoh ngalugmi. Iwe ngo yarmat cholop ila fiyong mele ye teptap bo yebe hamdefa meka ngalir, bo mil mala haremwo re kaloh kaloh ngo re towe wiri, ngo rela talenga talenga ngo re towe medaf.
Jesus Ye Hamdefa Molwe Fiyongol Chol Fadol Milay We
“Iye mele fael fiyong we: faesol ire we ila mala yalol Deus.
Faesol ire kowe ye pungdiy lal yalap ila ye wochog rechokla re rongrong mala yalol Deus ngo Satan ye budoh yesa hachuya mo lal deper bo deyoh le rebe chepar re sala molow.

Iwe ngo faesol ire kowe ye pungdiy lobos kowe ye faesfos ila ye wochog rechokla re rongrong mala yalol Deus ngo ye rraeyloh lal deper iyang. Iwe ngo yete sulay ngalir bo ye temachlong lal deper. Re bela chungu weres ngo ye ttir yal pung tangir yar tugul.

Iwe ngo faesol ire kowe ye pungdiy luwul ire kala yor chil ila ye wochog rechokla re rongrong mala yalol Deus ngo yar merahrah irel molow le yar wol talop mo yar hachangi mekla mmaler mele yesa totawoloh mala yalol Deus sala tor uwal mala yalol Deus mo irer.

Iwe ngo faesol ire kowe ye pungdiy loboka ye momay bol iyang ila ye wochog rechokla re rongrong mala yalol Deus iwe ngo ye mmochlong lal deper, iwe resa yedamgel chog yee la yor uwal mala yalol Deus mo irer.
Kaptal Habul We
“Tor semal le be hagsu sew habul yesa yetolong fael sew tapiy hare fael bet. Sima far hasi siya yetedah wol mokwe liliyel habul bo bela bulong semal ngo be wiri werel habul we.
“Te tugul sew formel le ye llebag ngo yebe llahloh. Ngo te tugul sew formel le be mel luwul ruchupung ngo be llahloh lal werloh.
“Ila ha itol dipmi irel yami ma hataleng bo semal le yor formel irel ngo yebe wol yoh ngali tot. Iwe ngo semal le tor formel irel ngo lepal sugfed le ye mel irel ngo rebe wol hasi tangi.”
Molwe Sil Mo Makawe Bisil Jesus
Mokwe wol bisil Jesus mo molwe sil re budoh irel ngo ye teyoh le re rol wer fengal bo sa cholop yarmat irel.
Iwe ngo semal yesa kangalu Jesus bo, “Molwe solom mo mokwe wol bisim ikala re mel ligtam le re dipli bo habe rol wer fengal.”
Jesus yesa kangalur bo, “Rechokla re rongrong mala yalol Deus ngo re itol deper iyang mele seley mo bisiy.”
Jesus Ye Hapasoloh Sew Laeng
Seral le Jesus mo mokwe redabeyal re dage seyay boat ngo Jesus yesa kangalur bo, “Siya loh mo rel laom le rela sere.” Iwe resa loh.
Yodwe re teteragloh ngo Jesus yesa masor loh. Re tedaploh chog ngo yesa kkel doh sew yaeng lal laom we ngo yesa momos boat we, ngo resa mel luwul hammerah.
Mokwe redabeyal resa faengludah ngo resa kangalu bo, “Masta, Masta! Sible mes!” Yesa chemdah Jesus yesa malili ngal yaeng mo lokowe re sala possloh. Iwe sala malululoh.
Iwe ngo yesa kasiyar bo, “Ifa tugul we yami?” Ir resa lluwdah ngo re motog ngo resa kasiy fengal uwor. “Itey mal le yebe malili ngal yaeng mo law ngo rema talenga yalol?”
Jesus Ye Hachuya Moniyan Mo Uwol Semal Mal
Jesus mo mokwe re dabeyal resa teragloh irel mekla faluyel Gerasa le ye mel rel Laom we Galilee rela sere.
Yodwe yela hola fulu ngo Jesus sala chungu semal mall haplom we le yor moniyan uwol. Yesa sulay yal tayma mengag ngo tayma mel lubugtal bo sa mamel fedal chog luwul tot pey.

Yodwe mal we yela wiri Jesus ngo yesa tawul le ye hapalingi yalol. Ngo yesa hachepragidiy mo imol Jesus ngo yesa malili moniyan we uwol le ye hapalingi yalol. “Jesus le Lol Deus le ye Hartal Tagiyet meda mele ho luluwale ngalyey? Fael pechem ngo ho towe hafohoyuyey!”

Moniyan we ye sor mele bo fal mala Jesus yesa kangalu bo be chuy mo uwol mal we. Yesa cholop yodka yema kkel doh moniyan wol mal we le haramwo re chena paol mo pechel ngo yema musdu. Iwe ngo moniyan we yesa hasiloh lobokla le ye tolmayloh.
Jesus yesa kasiya mal we bo, “Ifa idem?” Iwe yesa sor bo, “Ngang Buwa.” Ye sor mele bo fal mala ye cholop moniyan uwol.
Moniyan kawe resa hafal pechey Jesus bo towe fang diy ier lal Infiyerno.
Ye mel sew mwodol pabiy lengcher le re momongoy wol sew teplag. Ngo moniyan kowe resa hafael pechey Jesus bo be tahcher bo re bela mel uwol pabiy kowe. Iwe yesa tahcher.
Iwe moniyan kowe resa chuy mo uwol mal we re sala mel uwol pabiy kowe. Resa hamdawey pabiy kowe mo wol metal teplag we resa muslong lal chael we yar malom loh.
Chol hamongol pabiy kowe re wiri mokwe ye weldoh. Iwe re sala sor fedal luwul haplom ngo re wol kangalur chol milay.

Resa roloh yarmat bo rebe kemahoy mele sa wel. Rela budoh irel Jesus re sala wiri mal we le ye mel lengchel le sa chuy moniyan mo uwol, ngo yesa mengag, ngo yesa repiy. Panger rechokwe ngo resa motog.
Rechokwe re wiri molwe ye wel resa kangalur rechokwe re moch budoh sangsengal yael Jesus hachuya moniyan mo uwol mal we.
Iwe ngo pangal yeramtal fulu we ngo resa kangalu Jesus bo be chuy bo yesa kkel yar motog. Iwe Jesus yesa chudah yuchul boat we sa loh.
Mal we sa chuy moniyan mo uwol yesa hafaelpech ngal Jesus le ye sor bo, “Fael pechem ngo ibe daboh.” Iwe ngo Jesus sa halho le ye kangalu bo,
“Hola tefael loh lubugtam bo ho bela sor mokwe Deus sa faor ngalug.” Iwe mal we yesa loh luwul haplom we ye sala sor fedal mokwe Jesus yesa faor ngali.
Tarfefel We Lol Jairus Mo Fefel We Ye Yangsi Molwe Mengagul Jesus
Yodwe Jesus yela tefael ngal rel chael we sere ngo resa tteydoh yarmat bo rebe habngu bo resa rraey irel bo sa ssulay yar wedwed loh chog irel.
Iwe ngo yesa budoh semal mal le Jairus idal le iy semal tamol imwel tteywe yar. Yesa hasubgudiy mo imol Jesus ngo yesa hafaelpech bo Jesus yebe dabeloh irel imw la imwal.
Bo mala lol le moch seg mo ruwow lepal ragel ila sa cchow yal tomay ngo ila chog lepal lol tarfefel. Yodwe Jesus ye dedarloh ngo yarmat resa rol hapilsedaw doh mo isre mo isre iy.
Ye mel semal fefel luwulur rechokwe le sa seg mo ruwow raeg yal machpol. Sa tapeliloh lol salpiy irel paliyer togta ngo tor semal ir le ye yoh bo be hachuya yal tomay.
Yesa hadidilong luwul buwa we mo lutugrul Jesus sala yangsi ngachel molwe mengagol. Yodwe chog ngo ye chuyloh yal tomay.
Jesus sa kasiy, “Itey le ye yangsiyey?” Semal ngo ye sor bo te iy. Pedrus sa sor bo, “Masta, be ifa sengal chog ngo siya gola irel buwa le resa hadibal ngalug.”
Iwe ngo Jesus sa wol sor, “Semal sa yangsiyey, bo imeyafi le ye buyoy kkemal mo uwoy.”

Fefel we sa gola le yarmat resa gola bo iy molwe, iwe ngo yesa budoh irel Jesus le yesa rerer irel yal rusmes. Ye sala hasubgudiy mo imol Jesus. Fefel we yesa kangalu Jesus mo imol pangal yarmat fael mele yela yangsi iyang mo igegel ttiril yal chuyloh yal tomay.
Iwe Jesus yesa kangalu bo, “Layi, yam tugul mele yesa hachuya yam tomay. Ho loh luwul hopos.”
Yodwe ye chil kapatpat Jesus ngo semal re kakal hapatpat yesa budoh mo irel imw we imwel Jairus sa kangalu Jairus bo, “Sa mes molwe lom. Le maila yam hamachluku fedaley Sensey la.”
Jesus ye rongrong molwe ngo yesa kangalu Jairus bo, “Ho towe rusmes. Yebe luglug lal depom ngo be molow tefael mala lom.”
Yodwe yela hola doh imw we ngo te depal le yarmat rebe dabeylong yilim. Halachog Pedrus mo John mo James mo molwe sil mo temal yalwich we mele re bulong.
Pangal yarmat lobowe ngo resa tetangdi yalwich we ngo Jesus yesa kangalur bo, “Ha towe rol tang bo yalwich le ila yete mes bele yal masor chog.”
Resa mmaligli bo re gola le sa mes yalwich we.
Jesus yesa holu molwe paol yalwich we ngo yesa kangalu bo, “Chemdah!”
Yodwe chog yesa molow tefael tarfefel we. Iwe ngo sa chemdah. Ngo Jesus yesa kangalur bo rebe fang hal tarfefel we bo yebe mongoy.
Re lluwdah mokwe wulutugul yalwich we irel molwe. Iwe Jesus yesa kangalur bo tor semal le rebe kangalu kofal molwe.
